entities.name: Rajadhi Rajasinha of Kandy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sri Rajadhi Rajasinha was a member of the Madurai royal family and succeeded his brother, Kirti Sri Rajasinha as King of Kandy in 1782. He was known as a poet-king, with at least one poem written by his hand still known.
